description: This Java class represents data related to working days in the context of the Apache Fineract project. It includes properties such as recurrence patterns, rescheduling options, and flags for extending terms due to holidays or daily repayments. The class is serializable and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: WorkingDaysData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for transferring working days configuration details, including recurrence, rescheduling options, and holiday-related term extensions.
